evidence.name: Screen field: Slide supporting line
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Slide supporting line" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Slide supporting line
sections.description: The line under the headline, shown only when the slide template is Image + Title + Subtitle or richer. Use it to back up the headline with a quick proof point or detail rather than repeat it. It supports @variable personalization, countdown timers, and styled chips, is edited per language, and only appears after you set a slide template that includes a subtitle.
